title: Knowledge Blueprint v004: Deterministic Bootstrap Planning
purpose: Document the planning-stage design and measured output of the FORGE v004 knowledge blueprint before evidence acquisition or production knowledge generation.

validation_status.publication_status_reason: Published as a technical planning note rather than a verified production result because the source package explicitly states that user-environment validation had not yet been supplied.

limitations: The blueprint is a planning artifact, not a factual knowledge corpus.
No source URLs or evidence had been selected at this stage.
The 37-topic amendment was intentionally bounded and was not intended to be an exhaustive enterprise IT ontology.
Existing corrected taxonomy topics were not broadly reclassified into the two new amendment domains.
The source archive records local deterministic validation, but not completed user-environment validation.
